intros x y hxy
have h : 0 ≤ x := le_zero_iff_neg_zero.mpr (le_zero_iff_neg_zero.mp hxy)
have k : 0 ≤ y := le_zero_iff_neg_zero.mpr (le_zero_iff_neg_zero.mp hxy)
have l : x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0 := or.intro_left _ (ne_zero_of_gt hxy)
obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := l
have h1 : x ≠ 0 := hx
have h2 : y ≠ 0 := hy
let f := fun x => √x
have hf : DifferentiableOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) f := by
  intro x
  cases x with x'
  exact differentiable_at.sqrt x'
have hf' : HasDerivWithinAt f (1 / (2 * √x)) (Set.Ioi x) x := by
  intro x
  cases x with x'
  exact has_deriv_within_at.sqrt x'
have h_slope : slope f x y < f' := by
  apply StrictConcaveOn.slope_lt_of_hasDerivWithinAt_Ioi
  · exact Real.strictConcaveOn_negMulLog
  · exact h
  · exact hxy
  · exact hf'
exact h_slope
